svg.title: Archili Tskipuridze — Cybersecurity and GRC Engineering
svg.desc: A dark animated profile page featuring a text-built portrait, security orbit, the Aegis GRC project, and Archili's engineering toolbox.

g.text: Turning security claims into verifiable evidence
I treat security as a living engineering system:
controls tied to evidence, risks tied to owners,
and automation that never invents certainty.
STATUS: BUILDING SYSTEMS THAT CAN PROVE THEIR OWN CLAIMS
An AI-integrated, NIST CSF 2.0-oriented platform that turns frameworks,
controls, evidence, findings, risks, and audit trails into one trustworthy system.
FRAMEWORK → CONTROL → EVIDENCE → GAP → FINDING → REMEDIATION
TOOLS CHANGE. THE REQUIREMENT FOR TRUSTWORTHY EVIDENCE DOES NOT.
